content: {"argument": "The witness test expects www.a.com to become a.com after stripping WWW, but the current regex requires the first hostname label after www. to be at least 2 characters ([a-z\\-\\d]{2,64}). Since 'a' is only one character, the condition fails and www. is not stripped. However, DNS labels must be at least 1 character, so the regex should allow 1-character labels. The change mistakenly increased the minimum from 1 to 2, causing this regression.", "concedes": true}
